question: What does each divider shape draw, what do Width, Height, Flip, Alignment, Color and custom Thickness change, and what do the Video, Art and Color Theme Editor views hold?
note: All on a page made for the probe, unsaved, left through Exit Without Saving. Frame 1600 by 1000 unless named. Nothing uploaded; Reset Color Theme never pressed. Heights are shares of the band, measured along the stroke; the oracle's path rounds to 3 decimals, so a reading moves by up to 1 px.

noShape.note: band 0, no padding, a line along the section bottom

flipX.note: the height mirrors over the shape's own middle

flipY.note: the whole edge mirrors over the section middle, alignment too; Scalloped reads mirrored until pressed

alignment.moves: A/2 px left at any window size

slantedX.note: Flip X pressed on Wavy, then Slanted. Slanted has no Flip X button but keeps the flip: the height mirrors over the shape's own middle, as on every shape with the button. 40vw, 10vw, 300px.

softCorners: no Width or Alignment; the width is the section's, and the corners grow with the height

shuffle.note: Edit Settings' Shuffle: a pair from the S, M, L sizes and the flips; the shape and alignment stay. The shape was read on 17 presses in 3 sessions, 6 of them reading flips too; 10 more presses read only sizes and flips.

designTab.rule: The Shuffle button on the Design tab also moves to the next of the seven shapes, in one order that repeats, with a pair of sizes and the flips. No Shape is never picked, and it is left when it is the start. One undo a press. Alignment, Stroke and Thickness stay.
designTab.inferred: Each session has its own order (others started rounded, pointed, slanted, scalloped; and slanted, scalloped, rounded). Ours picks the order once per page load and skips the current shape, not read. Whether the order is per section is not read. Each flip with even odds.
designTab.flips: Read from the edge on Wavy and Slanted, which turn over from press to press in both places: Wavy's quarter point at the top or the bottom of the band, Slanted rising or falling.

video.storageTip: Your plan includes 30 minutes of free uploaded video storage.
video.fallback: Add an image to replace your video in mobile browsers. If left blank a background color will display. You can change this color in the Style panel.

art.note: Background art will only appear in browsers that support WebGL.

parts: Changes you make will affect all sections that use this colo
colorThemeEditor.close: Closes all of it, the section panel too (2026-11-06).
